stories.headline: US Inflation Report Keeps Fed on Track for December Rate Hike
stories.summary: US consumer prices rose firmly again in October, reinforcing the case for Federal Reserve policymakers to raise interest rates at next month's meeting. Fed Vice Chair Philip Jefferson said inflation has become the most important measure for policymakers, and the broader policy debate has already shifted to the January meeting.

stories.headline: Nvidia Leadership Shakeup Puts Succession and China Strategy in Focus
stories.summary: Wall Street is bracing for a post-Jensen Huang era at Nvidia after a leadership upheaval tied to a spy scandal, with CFO Colette Kress stepping in as interim CEO facing heavy scrutiny. Analysts describe the transition as a major 'key man risk' event with implications for the AI chip ecosystem and national security oversight of export controls.

stories.headline: Bessent, Lutnick Clash Over Nvidia China Chip Export Curbs
stories.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick are reported to be in conflict within the Trump administration over how far to restrict advanced Nvidia chip exports to China. The dispute comes as Nvidia's export-control overseer faces fresh scrutiny amid the company's leadership crisis.

stories.headline: SpaceX S&P 500 Bid Revived as Musk Pitches Tesla Merger
stories.summary: SpaceX may have found a backdoor route into the S&P 500 index through a potential merger with Tesla, as Elon Musk pitches the combination. The move would address SpaceX's prior hurdles to index inclusion while adding complexity to Tesla's corporate structure.

stories.headline: China, US Hold First Meeting of New Trade Tariff Council
stories.summary: China and the US held the first meeting of a new trade council by video on Friday under their economic and trade consultation mechanism, discussing tariffs. The talks come as Trump heads to China for discussions with Xi and Putin, with trade de-escalation a key focus for markets.

stories.headline: Italy Fines Meta €805 Million Over Unauthorized Access to User Photos
stories.summary: Italy's Data Protection Authority fined Meta Platforms €805 million (about $887 million) for accessing Android users' photo and video galleries without explicit consent. The penalty adds to Meta's growing list of regulatory fines in Europe over data privacy practices.

stories.headline: Microsoft Says Services Fully Restored After Major Global Outage
stories.summary: Microsoft said access was fully restored to its flagship software after an outage that paralyzed government offices, traders and businesses worldwide. The FBI is separately probing whether a software update, rather than a cyberattack, caused the related mass FAA air-traffic communication outage.

stories.headline: Oil Market Brimming With Crude Despite Tanker Attacks
stories.summary: Crude oil markets remain well-supplied even as attacks on tankers continue amid the ongoing Iran conflict, limiting the upside for prices despite geopolitical risk. The resilience of supply is capping volatility that would normally accompany such disruptions.
